MERIDIAN DOCUMENT INTAKE
QA Execution Report — Timeout and Upload Boundary
Document ID: QA-RUN-881 | Test suite: release-2026.10-acceptance | Executed: 2026-10-21
DEMO DATA NOTICE: Entire document is fictional and created for software demonstration.

ENVIRONMENT
Release: mdi-2026.10-rc3
Environment: staging configured from the production candidate bundle
Worker timeout in configuration export: 60 seconds
Test operator: Platform QA rotation

TEST QA-TIMEOUT-04 — JOB TIMEOUT
Input: synthetic PDF designed to keep processing active beyond 45 seconds.
Runs: 3
Observed durations: 61.4 seconds; 62.0 seconds; 61.7 seconds.
At 90 seconds after each submission, the job API returned status RETRYING.
Observed UI message in each run: “Processing failed.”
Expected under PRD-42: terminal FAILED state after 45 seconds, no automatic retry, and the approved user-readable timeout message.
Result recorded by QA: FAIL.

TEST QA-UPLOAD-07 — MAXIMUM FILE SIZE
Input: synthetic 75 MB PDF.
Observed response: HTTP 202 Accepted; a processing job was created.
Expected under PRD-42: HTTP 413 before a job is created for any file larger than 50 MB.
Result recorded by QA: FAIL.

SCOPE AND LIMITATIONS
These records describe the three timeout runs and one upload-boundary run listed above. They do not establish behavior for every file type, worker, region, or release. No passing rerun after a fix is attached to this report.

RECOMMENDED FOLLOW-UP
1. Align timeout, retry, and upload-size values with the approved requirement or obtain an approved requirement change.
2. Rerun QA-TIMEOUT-04 and QA-UPLOAD-07 after the change.
3. Capture request IDs, job IDs, actual state transitions, elapsed times, HTTP status, and the rendered UI message.
4. Attach the passing run report to the release approval record.
